overall: The AG found no Open Meeting Law violation: the Board could withhold redacted portions of its January 2013 tax-abatement executive session minutes because release would reveal protected abatement information.

allegations.summary: Complainant alleged the Board improperly withheld redacted portions of its January 2013 executive session minutes on tax abatement applications.
allegations.key_passage: Release of the redacted portions of the minutes at issue would allow a reader to infer information from certain abatement applications that is protected by statute from public disclosure.
